title: Trend Micro Apex One Security Agent Improper Certificate Validation Local Privilege Escalation Vulnerability
vulnerability_details: This vulnerability allows local attackers to escalate privileges on affected installations of Trend Micro Apex One. An attacker must first obtain the ability to execute low-privileged code on the target system in order to exploit this vulnerability. The specific flaw exists within the Apex One Client Plug-in Service Manager. The issue results from improper validation of a certificate. An attacker can leverage this vulnerability to escalate privileges and execute arbitrary code in the context of SYSTEM.
